body_markdown:
**SOUL 4.3 – Todo Descriptions, meep reactions and more:**


*Prerequisite for this update is an active SOUL+ contract and a Protonet server with SOUL version stable /xxx. You will see the version after logging* into your SOUL on the help page.


- **New to do description feature:**
- **Meep Reactions:**


- ******Task Lists redesign. List/grid view, pinned lists for user/group and filters:******


- ******Implements list view for events:******


- ******Open user profile details on sidebar from anywhere on SOUL, without leaving the current position:******


- ****Change language flow improvement, there is no more need to refresh the browser after changing the language on SOUL:****


# Bug Fixes:


- ‘Open’ button on the notifications sidebar is fixed


- Fixed document mentions
- Added fix for modal window while sidebar is opened
- Setting a meep reminder does not mark the meep as ‘edited’ anymore


# Under the hood:


- Trash bin refactoring, this improves performance within the recycle bin.


---


**When was the last time you created a backup copy of your SOUL?**


Find out how easy it is to back up your data[here](https://support.protonet.info/en/faq/cat-faq/faq/#how-do-i-create-a-backup-of-my-protonet-server) .


Before contacting support please refer to our[SUPPORT PROCESS](https://support.protonet.info/en/faq/support-process/) FAQ.
